name: ai-party-school
description: 基于 AI 的数智党校学习系统 - A08 赛题

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,admin,mobile -c blue,green,magenta "cd packages/server && npx nest start --watch" "cd packages/admin && npx vite" "cd packages/mobile && npx vite"
scripts.db:init: pnpm --filter server prisma:dbpush && pnpm --filter server prisma:seed
scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter admin build && pnpm --filter mobile build
scripts.package:server:linux: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter server prisma:generate && pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter admin build && pnpm --filter mobile build && node scripts/precompress.cjs && node scripts/package-server-release.cjs
